nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Central config — edit vault path, excluded paths, model name here

nodes.name: Read Housekeeping.md
nodes.notes: Reads Obsidian Housekeeping.md via Local REST API

nodes.name: Find All Files (SSH)
nodes.notes: SSH find: all .md files across all target paths — no modified-since filter. Paths read from Config targetPaths.

nodes.name: Write Needed?
nodes.notes: Gates the write — true branch (writeNeeded: true) proceeds to Write File, false branch skips directly to Aggregate Results.

nodes.name: Write File
nodes.notes: Writes cleaned content back only if tasks were removed.

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const base = $('Config').item.json.obsidianBaseUrl; const p = $('Clean Completed Tasks').item.json.filePath; const encoded = p.split('/').map(s => encodeURIComponent(s)).join('/'); return `${base}/vault/${encoded}`; })() }}

nodes.name: Build Log Entry
nodes.notes: Builds new log entry from aggregated results, prepends to existing log, trims to 10 days

nodes.name: Write Log Entry
nodes.notes: Writes full log file back via PUT

nodes.name: Write Control File
nodes.notes: Writes full log file back via PUT

nodes.name: Parse Config
nodes.notes: Parses target paths, excluded paths, threshold, and last run from the weekly control file.

nodes.name: Filter & Parse File List
nodes.notes: Strips vault prefix from SSH find output, applies exclusion filter from Config. No last-run filter — weekly scans everything.
